# tomswallapi_binding (Resource)

Binds a global zone to a device's local interface(s) — the only legitimately host-specific object in the model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_binding" "fw1_loc" {
  device     = "fw1"
  zone       = "loc"
  interfaces = ["eth1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Device name.
- `interfaces` (List of String) Local interface names this zone attaches to on the device, e.g. ["eth1"].
- `zone` (String) Global zone name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by device:zone.
terraform import tomswallapi_binding.fw1_loc fw1:loc
```
